2609.33974.title: Beyond Solo and Consistency: Vindicating Multi-Agent Debate via Conditional Progressive Pruning
2609.33974.paper_summary: Large Language Model (LLM) based Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) is one of the most effective test time scaling techniques. Through multi-round communication, agents complement each other in knowledge and reasoning and solve tasks that no single member can solve. However, existing MAD frameworks fail to beat strong Single Agent and Consistency-based baselines under the same strict cost limit, which shakes the foundation of the MAD field. We propose Conditional Progressive Pruning (CPP), a lightweight pruning framework that fully exploits multi-round MAD. CPP outperforms all existing MAD frameworks on multiple dominated benchmarks. It is also the first to fully outperform consistency methods. Our code, detailed agent interaction records will be released soon.
2609.33974.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）基於多代理辯論（MAD）是最有效的測試時間擴展技術之一。<lb/>通過多輪交流，代理在知識和推理上互補，解決單一成員無法解決的任務。<lb/>然而，現有的MAD框架在相同的嚴格成本限制下未能超越強大的單一代理和基於一致性的基準，這動搖了MAD領域的基礎。<lb/>我們提出了條件漸進修剪（CPP），這是一個輕量級的修剪框架，充分利用多輪MAD。<lb/>CPP在多個主導基準上超越了所有現有的MAD框架。<lb/>它也是首個全面超越一致性方法的框架。<lb/>我們的代碼和詳細的代理互動記錄將很快發布。
